The '''S/ig-30 hyperdrive system''' was a model of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The engine was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] and sold for 6400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
